notes.sullivan-ice-arena: Thomas F. Sullivan Ice Arena is the hockey arena, a varsity venue rather than the student gym (anselm.edu campus map).
notes.new-hampshire-institute-of-politics-and-: The NH Institute of Politics is an institute with classrooms and events (anselm.edu/about/offices-centers-institutes/centers-institutes/new-hampshire-institute-politics); Geisel Library is the college library, so NHIOP ranks as a class building.
notes.perini-lecture-hall: OSM names the Goulet Science Center building by its Perini Lecture Hall; the alias lets schedules that say Goulet match it (anselm.edu campus map marks Goulet Science Center at this building).
